scope: Three quantitative homepage indicators, not a census of all research claims.
policy: Null means unmeasured or unreported, never zero. Figures are from linked sources; do not treat them as independently reproduced unless stated.

claims.label: Max absolute logit identity error
claims.comparator: repeated clean baseline; self-overwrite; final-state logit-lens checks
missing: No interval reported; implementation check, not a population estimate
claims.provenance: Manus-run Mottled portability study; Mottled commit f244c6e; batch size 1
claims.limitation: Checks instrument consistency, not generality of causal transplant results.

claims.label: Same − unrelated transfer efficiency
claims.uncertainty: Pair-clustered 95% bootstrap interval [−0.363, −0.224]; paired sign-flip p = 3.05×10⁻⁵
claims.limitation: One model and one factual-cloze intervention; experiment not independently replicated.

claims.label: Mean neighbourhood preservation
claims.unit: fraction across four saved sample scenes
missing: No interval reported across independent runs
claims.provenance: Mottled fidelity_summary on four sample scenes, as reported in homepage ledger
claims.limitation: In 3/4 scenes, more than half the states fall below the 0.5 fidelity flag. Not evidence of predictive usefulness.
